title: Building the COSY Master Curriculum Across 14 Target Languages
dek: An architectural breakdown of the Top 100 semantic master tree, CEFR alignment, and cross-language vocabulary integration across all 14 COSY target languages.

blocks.text: Architectural Principles of the Master Curriculum
blocks.say: Building a unified curriculum across 14 languages requires a single semantic master tree. Each domain connects core nouns, action verbs, and survival expressions.

blocks.text: From English and French to Armenian, Georgian, Tatar, and Breton, the COSY Master Curriculum aligns CEFR progression with native target-language definitions and COSYdata repositories.
blocks.say: Aligned CEFR progression ensures every language learner enjoys a structured path.
100 ordered semantic chains organized into 10 progressive domains.

blocks.title: Cross-Linguistic Harmony
blocks.content: Designing a curriculum for 14 languages requires respecting regional orthographies (Cyrillic, Greek, Armenian, Georgian) while preserving identical pedagogical milestones across all tracks.
